item.title: Open PDF Editor 0.2.0
item.description: Annotations. Highlight, underline and strike through text; add notes, text boxes, rectangles, ovals, lines, arrows, freehand drawings and stamps from the new markup toolbar (⇧⌘A). Select an annotation to move or resize it, or change its colour, fill, opacity, line width and text in the inspector. The new Comments sidebar lists every annotation with replies and review status, and filters by type, author and status. Everything can be undone, even after saving; documents save automatically, with File › Revert To for earlier versions. Saving adds your changes to the end of the file, so digital signatures stay valid. Tools › Flatten Annotations makes them part of the pages.
